shortDescription: Stolen funds from Notional Finance’s custodial contract included about $1.7 million in DAI and USDC, which the attacker later exchanged for 689.2 ETH and deposited into the Tornado Cash mixing protocol. According to Odaily, the funds were moved after the theft.
